# The works whose time ran out this month (DA_WW_monthly fires this event when a DA_WW_due_P flag is set).
# It fires the finishing event of each such wonder. From its option, as Anbennar does for Stromolgiv
# (flavor_krakazol.202 and .203): the finishing event then has this country as FROM, which
# add_great_project_tier needs.
country_event = {
	id = DA_wonder_works.100
	title = DA_wonder_works.100.t
	desc = DA_wonder_works.100.d
	picture = GREAT_BUILDING_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = DA_wonder_works.a
		if = {    # Fireglass Forge
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_due_4039 has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4039 owns = 4039 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.101 }
		}
		if = {    # Titanium Vault
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_due_4217 has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4217 owns = 4217 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.102 }
		}
		if = {    # Argrâstun Cathedral
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_due_4284 has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4284 owns = 4284 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.103 }
		}
		if = {    # Ancient Research Facility
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_due_4119 has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4119 owns = 4119 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.104 }
		}
		if = {    # Amldavhad Training Facility
			limit = { has_country_flag = DA_WW_due_4236 has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4236 owns = 4236 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.105 }
		}

# One finishing event per wonder: the tier, then what the old button did on the day of the purchase, then the
# notice. No else and no else_if anywhere (see the head of wonder_pages_script.py): the tier being raised
# is read into DA_WW_tier_P first, and each tier has its own plain if.

country_event = { # Fireglass Forge: the works are finished
	id = DA_wonder_works.101
	title = DA_wonder_works.100.t
	desc = DA_wonder_works.100.d
	picture = GREAT_BUILDING_eventPicture
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = DA_WW_building_4039
		owns = 4039
	}
	option = {
		name = DA_wonder_works.a
		# the tier these works raise, read before it changes
		set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { 4039 = { has_great_project = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 2 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 3 } }
		4039 = { add_great_project_tier = { type = DA_Magma_Forge tier = 1 } }
		if = {    # tier I
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 2 } } }
			DA_FG_sync = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.6 days = 30 }
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.11 days = 365 }
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.12 days = 1095 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
		}
		if = {    # tier II
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 2 } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 3 } } }
			DA_FG_sync = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.7 days = 30 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
		}
		if = {    # tier III
			limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_WW_tier_4039 value = 3 } }
			DA_FG_sync = yes
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.8 days = 30 }
			country_event = { id = DA_Magma_forge_event.14 days = 3650 }
			country_event = { id = DA_wonder_works.1 }
		}
		DA_WW_clear_4039 = yes
		DA_WW_refresh_4039 = yes
	}
}
